components.name: Arc Hammer
components.blurb: A ram tube, a hammer head and two ball electrodes that should not touch and do. Hits like a dropped bridge, then the bridge sparks. Mind the soft crew.
components.quirk: Kinetic hammer with an ion kick (a heavy hit, and the room it hits is stunned 1.5 s), but it shocks organic crew in its own room (2 hp a second while it fires). Gauntlings are mechanical.

components.name: Scrap Shotgun
components.blurb: Two sawn-off pipes and a hopper of whatever was lying about. It fires the hopper. Seizes up one time in seven; we call that character.
components.quirk: Cheap (a scrap-heavy recipe, scrap ammo), six pellets and shard splinters, but 15% of volleys jam. Gauntlings mend a jam x0.8 the time.

components.name: Tesla Picket
components.blurb: A coil, a ball and a wire to your last good fuse. Chains the lightning from one system to the next. The gunner's hair is not what it was.
components.quirk: Ion beam that chains to the cells beside the hit, but its room is a shock hazard for organic crew (1.5 hp a second). Gauntlings are mechanical.

components.name: Arc Core
components.blurb: Copper ring, steel ball, arcs to the four corner posts. Plenty of power for those made of metal. Visitors, step round the posts.
components.quirk: +3 power over a Reactor Mk1, but it shocks organic crew in its room (1 hp a second). Gauntlings are mechanical and don't notice.

components.name: Overclock Engine
components.blurb: Two bells that never matched, a copper coil between. Screams for a pilot with the right wiring and sulks for the wrong sort. The wrong sort gets a tingle.
components.quirk: Thrust x1.5 (27) with a mechanical crew member in its room; without one it makes the Mk2's 18. It shocks organic crew in its room (1 hp a second).

components.name: Graft Bay
components.blurb: Work table, two welding arms, a rack of spares. Fixes our own at double speed. Flesh may leave a limb behind.
components.quirk: Mechanical crew work x2 in it, but organic crew take 1 hp a second.
